name: gpu-v1
description: GPU RMA validation. Full-load kill test first, then isolates FP32 CUDA cores, FP16/TF32 tensor cores, and FP64 double-precision paths. CPU at moderate load to keep PSU warm without masking GPU symptoms.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. Capture reference temps, clocks, voltages for drift rules.

phases.name: full-load
phases.notes: 5 min tensor cores + large matrix. Kill test — max power, max VRAM bandwidth. Dead GPU crashes here.

phases.name: fp32-cuda-cores
phases.notes: 8 min FP32 SGEMM on CUDA cores only. No tensor cores. Exercises the traditional shader/ALU pipeline.

phases.name: fp16-tensor-cores
phases.notes: 8 min FP16/TF32 tensor core GEMM. Max power draw. Dedicated matrix multiply units — where most AI/ML workloads live.

phases.name: fp64-double-precision
phases.notes: 8 min FP64 DGEMM. Consumer GPUs have 1/64 FP64 throughput vs FP32 — lower power but isolates the double-precision path.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 5 min cooldown. Clock recovery, post-load AER check, thermal hysteresis.
